data: Approximately at which epoch does the blue line intersect the orange line?

The blue line represents the performance of the model trained on general-domain data, while the orange line represents the performance of the model trained on in-domain data. The intersection point of these two lines indicates the epoch at which their performance is approximately equal. From the graph, it appears that the blue line intersects the orange line around epoch 2.
